name: Vanocker Campground and RV Park
note: Small campground on the south edge of Sturgis bordering the Black Hills NF (1214 Pineview Dr), open all summer with roll-ins welcome. Full-hookup RV sites $59, 30/50-amp electric sites with water fill $49 (dump on site), tent sites, dry cabins; wifi, laundry, shower house. --Claude

RV Life unrated -> needs a published base rate <= $50: the electric site at $49 passes. Google 4.6 over 81 at the address with phone

name: 3 Sons' RV Resort
note: Large RV park on the east edge of Yankton (705 S Timberland Dr): three tiers of sites with soft-water hookups, pool, clubhouse, fishing pond, camper rentals. Camping spots $50-55 a night on the online booking (advertised from $35). --Claude

name: SPOT Campground
note: Small, shaded campground on the east side of De Smet beside a pond, handy for the Laura Ingalls Wilder sites: large sites, many full-hookup and pull-through. Passport America park; no operator website - book by phone. RV Life 4*/$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: RV Life 4* $$ over 14 reviews (>= 10 decides quality alone; $$ passes price with no check), not flagged closed, read 2026-10-03; Google 'SPOT Campground' listing at the pin with phone (3.6 over 33) = live presence under the Google rule; listed on Passport America (CampgroundId 741)

name: Schmidt's Landing
note: Fishing resort on the South Dakota shore of Big Stone Lake (481422 Schmidts Rd, Big Stone City): rows of 30-amp electric sites (some with water), water fill and dump, showers, c-store, boat and pontoon rentals, swimming beach, private launch, docks, lakeside suites. About $34 a night (2026 stay). --Claude

name: Dakota Sioux Casino RV Park
note: Row of about 14 pull-through RV pads with water and 20/30/50-amp electric south of the Dakota Sioux Casino & Hotel, off I-29 exit 185 near Watertown (16415 Sioux Conifer Rd). $25 a night plus tax, rigs to 50 ft, register at the hotel; summer only (closed fall and winter). --Claude
